mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (username, password, email, status, role) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{status}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, email, password, status, role, create_time, update_time FROM account ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.username, up.avatar_url, up.bio, COUNT(f.id) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS work_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON a.id = up.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING total_favorites > 0 ORDER BY total_favorites DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.username, up.avatar_url, up.bio, COUNT(f.id) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS work_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON a.id = up.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id AND f.create_time >= #{weekStart} WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING total_favorites > 0 ORDER BY total_favorites DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM account a LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(f.id) > 0) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM account a LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id AND f.create_time >= #{weekStart} WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(f.id) > 0) t
SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, quota, status, role, create_time, update_time FROM account WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET quota = quota - #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND quota >= #{amount}
UPDATE account SET quota = quota + #{amount} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account SET quota = #{quota} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, quota, status, role, create_time, update_time FROM account WHERE email = #{email}
